meta.name: git-commit
meta.description: Create well-structured git commits with conventional commit messages. Use when asked to commit changes, prepare a commit, or stage and push code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用规范格式提交代码变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要写 Git 提交信息并推送代码
copy.tagline_en: Commit code changes with conventional messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write Git commit messages and push code

howto.what: 当你请求提交代码时，Claude会先检查改动，将相关文件分组，逐组暂存，并用规范格式（类型、范围、说明、正文、结尾）编写提交信息，最后只提交合理的单个更改。
howto.when: 当你要求提交更改、准备提交、或暂存并推送代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交当前所有更改
say.note: Claude将自动分组并生成规范提交信息。

say.text: 为修复的bug创建一个提交
say.note: Claude会使用fix类型，只暂存与该bug相关的文件。

say.text: 把新功能分开提交，不要混在一起
say.note: Claude会将新功能与修复等无关更改分开提交。

howto.what_en: When you ask to commit code, Claude will check changes, group related files, stage them intentionally, and write a structured commit message following the Conventional Commits format, ensuring each commit contains only logical changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit changes, prepare a commit, or stage and push code.

say_en.note: Claude will auto-group and write proper commit messages.

say_en.text: Create a commit for the bug fix.
say_en.note: Claude will use 'fix' type and stage only related files.

say_en.text: Keep the new feature commits separate.
say_en.note: Claude will separate unrelated changes into distinct commits.
